description: Claude Code and Cowork plugins from Tequity. UI/UX and accessibility auditing, with more to come.

plugins.name: ui-ux-audit
plugins.description: Three-phase UI/UX and accessibility auditing: Figma designs before code, UI source, and the running app via Argent. A go/no-go verdict with WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2 status per level, audit memory across re-audits, guided intake, a choosable audit scope, reproducible scoring, an adversarial verification gate, and a themed HTML and PDF report with screenshots marked at the finding.
